tickerText: [TENNIS] US Open quarter-finals set — Alcaraz beat Paul and faces Shelton, Tiafoe topped Medvedev to meet Michelsen in an all-American clash, while Sabalenka and Noskova advance to a women's quarter-final showdown • [SQUASH] London Classic crowns champions at Ally Pally — Paul Coll swept Victor Crouin for a third straight title and 34th PSA crown, while Amina Orfi retained the women's trophy with a 3-0 win over Georgina Kennedy • [BADMINTON] China Masters wraps in Shenzhen — An Se-young claimed her seventh title of 2026, Jason Gunawan made Hong Kong history in men's singles, and Satwik-Chirag won men's doubles ahead of the Asian Games • [PICKLEBALL] Heineken Pickleball World Cup ends in Da Nang — the USA swept Vietnam 4-0 for Open team gold as Ly Hoang Nam won men's singles on home soil • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Contender Almaty concludes — Shunsuke Togami and Miu Hirano took singles titles as the WTT Champions Macao draw is set for play starting Tuesday

newsItems.title: US Open Quarter-Finals Set
newsItems.excerpt: Carlos Alcaraz beat Tommy Paul and will face Ben Shelton after the American ousted Stefanos Tsitsipas, while Frances Tiafoe topped Daniil Medvedev to set up an all-American quarter-final against Alex Michelsen.

newsItems.title: Coll and Orfi Crowned at London Classic
newsItems.excerpt: Paul Coll swept Victor Crouin for his third straight London Classic title and 34th PSA crown, while defending champion Amina Orfi retained the women's trophy with a dominant 3-0 win over Georgina Kennedy.

newsItems.title: An Se-young Retains China Masters
newsItems.excerpt: World No. 1 An Se-young beat Tomoka Miyazaki for her seventh title of 2026, Jason Gunawan won Hong Kong's first Super 750 men's singles crown, and Satwik-Chirag finally captured the men's doubles trophy in Shenzhen.

newsItems.title: USA Wins Pickleball World Cup
newsItems.excerpt: The United States swept Vietnam 4-0 in the Heineken Pickleball World Cup Open team final in Da Nang, with Ly Hoang Nam winning men's singles gold as the host nation finished runners-up on home soil.
